items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...where does the drummer like Cozy Cole, how do you describe what he does? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, now, he plays -- while he was in Cab's band, he played a good Eastern beat.

ctx.x: That's why I said, if -- that the rhythm section makes the band. Remember that Basie band, remember, and think of Duke Ellington's band, and you remember how they used to spank a song. In that rhythm section, they were spanking it! They were beating heck out of it. Those horns had to play, I don't care -- I used to say -- in fact, they used to say that you get anybody in Duke Ellington's band, with a rhythm section like that, on you, you'd better play or you're going to jump out of (inaudible) the stand.

Well, what about -- now, one of the things that I wanted to talk to you about, when you're talking of the lazy beat, the behind beat, now, where does the drummer like Cozy Cole, how do you describe what he does?
Well, now, he plays -- while he was in Cab's band, he played a good Eastern beat.
